---
name: Missed error
about: The OMR output was wrong and the proofreader said nothing
title: "[Miss] "
labels: missed-error
---

**The error**
What the page shows, and what the file says instead.

**Where**
Part, measure, staff, voice.

**Files, if you can share them**
The scan, the OMR output, and — if you have it — your corrected version. All three together make
a complete evaluation case, which is the most useful thing anyone can contribute to this project.

**Does it leave a trace in the music?**
Optional, but it decides where the fix belongs. If the wrong note still fits the harmony, the
rhythm and every repeat of the figure, no rule can find it and it is evidence for the computer
vision channel (Phase 2) rather than for a new rule.
